author: KEXP
description: The ethereal vocals of Belle & Sebastian founding member Isobel Campbell fills the KEXP Live Room in our latest in-studio session. With songs from across her discography, Campbell offers a stunning performance of "Saturday's Gone" and more.
title: Isobel Campbell performs "Saturday's Gone" & more Live on KEXP
